evidence.reason: The current tip handles missing prunable in-root worktree registrations before bindCheckout and the unpushed-work guard: it lstats the path, treats ENOENT as absent, validates the porcelain HEAD, checks `${expectedSha}..${candidate.head}` from repoRoot, and removes only that registration non-forced when no unpushed work exists, preserving it if unpushed work or an unknown HEAD remains. This addresses the reported failure without global pruning or bypassing the guard. Fixed by commit 0f133e9d0a4248698e2d16aecf9e96c8c952e9b1.
